subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------PR.INT.
description: Second diagram on page 469, paired with OP-SPD × POL-P above. Where the first diagram shows the structural shape of western-art-music's always-already-there funding, this one names what projection-dynamics meets when it actually goes out into the world without that funding: PROJ-DY (projection dynamics) crossed with PR-INT (the principle interior — the receiving culture's already-formed interior dispositions about which forms are 'real' art). PROJ-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; AFI (affinity insight) hangs below as the projection's immediate downward output and PRI-AF-TD (principle-affinity transformation-dynamics) at the bottom-left as the deeper output. SPT-DY (spectacle dynamics) sits at the bottom-center as the bridging-axis terminus. (R)OBS (the reality of observation) rises at top-center and T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) sits centrally as the bridging hub. PR-INT sits as partner-axis at center-right with MOT-DY (motion dynamics) hanging below as the partner's downward output. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) rises at upper-right and INFO-DY (information dynamics) and RT-DY (reality dynamics) sit on the right as partner-side stacked outputs. Structural argument: projection-dynamics reaches principle-interior only across the T-C-IMP hub — projection routes through temporal-continuity-implication into the partner's reality-dynamics chain. The upper diagonal from (R)OBS down to T-C-IMP is the load-bearing edge: observation is what makes temporal-continuity-implication available to projection. For western art music, that route is reinforced by every institution; for creative music from the black aesthetic in the cycle the prose names ('the 1954 liberal cycle'), the observation-edge is structurally absent — when 'Patricia Von Dupotstein' (Braxton's invented name) performs at Alice Tully Hall, T-C-IMP is supplied by institutional reflex, not by actual reality-of-observation. The projection-dynamics of creative musicians without that institutional reflex must hold (R)OBS → T-C-IMP open themselves, and SPT-DY then becomes the only working terminus rather than reaching the partner's MOT-DY.
